# ui::ChildVisitor

Header: `winui/ui/Element.hpp`.

What [Element::for_each_child()](element.md#for_each_child) calls once per child: a non-owning reference to any callable taking an [`Element&`](element.md), two pointers wide, so walking the tree allocates nothing. It refers to the callable it was made from and must not outlive it, which a lambda passed straight to for_each_child() never does.

## ChildVisitor

```cpp
template <typename F>
ChildVisitor(F&& visit) noexcept
    requires (!std::is_same_v<std::remove_cvref_t<F>, ChildVisitor> && std::is_invocable_v<F&, Element&>)
```
